paite: Huchi in Job in TOUPA dawng hichi in achi.
"Thil bangkim na hihthei chih leh nang thiltup kham theih ahi kei chih ka thei hi.
heading: Job Thugen Nanungpen
english: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.

paite: Hiai thuhilhna theihna tel lou a sel kua ahia? Huaiziak in ka theihsiam louh, ka theih louh, kei a dia thillamdang luate ka genkhia hi.
english: You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand, things too wonderful for me, which I didn’t know.

paite: "Za in, ka hon ngen ahi, ka pau ding; nang ka hon phut ding, kei lam ah nang puang in, na hon chi hi.
english: You said, ‘Listen, now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you will answer me.’

paite: Zakna bil in nang ka hon za a; himahleh tu in ka mit in ka hon mu a,
english: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.

paite: Huaiziak in ka kikih a, leivui leh meivu ah ka kisik hi."
english: Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huchi a TOUPA'N Job kiang a hiai thute agen khit in, TOUPA'N Teman mi Eliphaz kiang ah, "Ka hehna nang tung leh na lawm nihte tung ah akuang, ka sikha Job bang a noute'n ka tanchin thil dik na gen louh ziak un," achi hi.
heading: Thukhitna Thu
english: It was so, that after Yahweh had spoken these words to Job, Yahweh said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends; for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.

paite: "Huaiziak in tu in, bawngtal sagih leh belamtal sagih la unla, ka sikha Job kiang ah hoh unla, nou a ding in halmang thillat lan un; huchi in noute a ding in ka sikha Job athum ding a; amah vang in ka sang dia, huchi in na haina uh dungzui in na tung uah ka hih kei ding; ka sikha Job bang in lah ka tanchin thil dik na gen kei uh," chi in.
english: Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept him, that I not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.”

paite: Huchi in Teman mi Eliphaz leh Shuah mi Bildad leh Naamath mi Zophar akuan ua, TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in ahihta uhi. TOUPA'N Job asangta hi.
english: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did what Yahweh commanded them, and Yahweh accepted Job.

paite: Alawmte a dia Job athum zoh in TOUPA'N Job saltanna akiheisak a, TOUPA'N Job ama a aneih zahnih apeta hi.
heading: Job Lehnih Vualzawlna
english: Yahweh restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. Yahweh gave Job twice as much as he had before.

paite: Huai lai in akiang ah, a-unaute tengteng leh asanggamnute tengteng leh tuma lam a amel theihsa tengteng leh a-insung a tanghou amah toh nete ahong pai ua, amah anem ua, TOUPA'N atung a hoih lou atunsak tengteng tungtang thu ah amah alungmuan uhi. Michih in leng ama sum leh michih in dangka-eng bilbah apia uhi.
english: Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before, came to him and ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him, and consoled him concerning all the evil that Yahweh had brought on him. Everyone also gave him a piece of money, and everyone a ring of gold.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Job tawpna lam a kipatna lam sang in anak vualzawl zaw hi. Belam singkhat-le-sangli leh sangawngsau sangguk leh bawngtal sangkhat leh sabengtungnu sangkhat anei hi.
english: So Yahweh blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.

paite: Tapa sagih leh tanu thum leng anei hi.
english: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

paite: Amasapen, Jemima achi a; anihna min, Kezia; athumna min, Keren-happuk.
english: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.

paite: Huchi in gamsung pumpi ah Job tanute bang a melhoih a-om kei uh; apa un a-unaute lak ah goutan amaute apia hi.
english: In all the land were no women found so beautiful as the daughters of Job. Their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.

paite: Huai nung in Job, kum za-le-sawmli adam a, atapate leh atapate' tapate, khang lina tan amu hi.
english: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.

paite: Huchi in Job atek mahmah a, a-upat tak ziak in asita hi.
english: So Job died, being old and full of days.
